payout_quote: Dallas County (May 26, 2026 Primary pay order): Election Day presiding judges $24.22/hour; clerks $18.24/hour; work window runs from two hours before polls open through two hours after polls close or last voter. Training: $100 advanced, $48 basic.
steps: Apply as a Dallas County poll worker
Work the official window (2 hrs before open through 2 hrs after close)
catches: Rates are election-specific (this order covers the May 26, 2026 primary) — other elections may differ.
16-hour work window on Election Day (5 a.m.–9 p.m. around 7 a.m.–7 p.m. polls).
Training pay is separate and lower than the working rate.
biggest_catch: Election-specific pay order — the $24.22/$18.24 rates apply to the May 2026 primary; always check the current election's order.
timing: Paid per county payroll after the election.
